title: How Telegram became profitable: Premium, privacy-first ads, Stars and bonds (2021-2026)
summary: Pavel Durov's channel posts trace Telegram's path from zero revenue to profit. He explains privacy-conscious ads, the Premium subscription, a stack of new monetization products and debt financing through bonds. The through-line: revenue exists to fund independence and put users first.

principles.text: Monetize without compromising privacy: no personal-data targeting, ads only in public one-to-many channels.
principles.quote: we took a privacy-conscious approach to ads: we decided that no personal data should be used for targeting and that promoted messages should only be shown in public one-to-many channels.

principles.text: Privacy-respecting ads can still beat the market, so you don't have to trade user trust for revenue.
principles.quote: Despite that, our ads have significantly outperformed the market and put Telegram on a steady path towards financial sustainability.

principles.text: Treat revenue as a tool for user value, not users as a tool for revenue.
principles.quote: While some other apps consider their users a tool to maximize revenue, we consider revenue a tool to maximize value for our users.

principles.text: Add a subscription tier alongside ads; Premium grew into one of the most successful social media subscriptions.
principles.quote: Telegram Premium, which we introduced just 5 months ago, quickly surpassed 1 million subscribers and has become one of the most successful examples of a social media subscription plan ever launched.

principles.text: Diversify monetization with many products (Stars, Gifts, Mini Apps, Affiliate, Business) to reach sustainable profit while staying independent.
principles.quote: Our innovations in monetization this year (⭐️ Stars, 🎁 Gifts, 🪙 Giveaways, 🖥 Mini Apps, 🤝 the Affiliate Platform, 💼 Telegram Business, and 📥 Telegram Gateway…) demonstrate that social media platforms can achieve financial sustainability while staying independent and respecting users' rights.

principles.text: Use debt (bonds) rather than equity to fund growth and keep control; Durov stays the sole shareholder.
principles.quote: bondholders are not shareholders and have no say over Telegram’s decisions. I am the sole shareholder.
